Welcome back to the channel. Today we are reviewing three budget phones under fifteen thousand rupees, and I have been using all of them for two weeks. The first one has the best battery, easily a day and a half with heavy use. The camera is decent in daylight but struggles indoors. The second phone has a brighter screen and faster charging, but it heats up when you play games for more than twenty minutes. The third one is the surprise. It is slower on paper, yet it feels smooth, and the speakers are the loudest of the three.
